page.overview:
What is Pokémon Gold and Silver?

Pokémon Gold Version and Pokémon Silver Version are the collective third core game installments of the Pokémon franchise. They are the first Generation II games. Pokémon Gold Version and Pokémon Silver Version take place in the Johto region, along with the returning Kanto region, and introduce 100 species of Pokémon, in addition to the 151 returning from Generation I.

About a year after the games were released, they would receive an upper version, titled Pokémon Crystal Version. In 2010, both games received remakes for the Nintendo DS, Pokémon HeartGold Version and Pokémon SoulSilver Version.

The game starts in the player's house in New Bark Town. The player's mom informs him that Professor Elm has an errand for him to run, discovering what Mr. Pokémon has to show. Professor Elm gives the player a choice of three Pokémon: Chikorita, Cyndaquil, or Totodile. Once discovering that Mr. Pokémon's surprise is a Pokémon egg.

Back in New Bark Town, the player encounters another boy standing outside of Elm Pokémon Lab. A battle occurs, and the player discovers that the boy has stolen a Pokémon from Elm. After defeating his new rival, the player can name him.
